panels.title: Average WebSocket completion latency per second

targets.query: SELECT sum("value") FROM "completion_failures" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(0)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "vus" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(null)

SELECT SUM("delta") AS "delta_per_sec" 
FROM (
    SELECT DIFFERENCE("value") AS "delta" 
    FROM "gc_count_G1 Young Generation"
    WHERE $timeFilter
) 
GROUP BY time(10s) fill(0)
